facts.text: Serve the cornbread when Rooster and LaBoeuf start shooting corn dodgers out of the air.
facts.why: Wikipedia and the other pages opened for the 2010 film never mention a corn dodgers shooting scene. It may belong to the 1969 film or the book, and I could not confirm it in this film.
facts.fix: Serve the cornbread when Mattie catches up with Rooster and LaBoeuf on the trail.

facts.why: No source shows Mattie drinking sarsaparilla. Cogburn is shown drinking heavily.
facts.fix: Sarsaparilla for a girl on a mission. Rooster's is stronger.

facts.why: The sources opened do not mention a boarding house in Fort Smith, so the venue name and the 'boarding house' dishes are unconfirmed for this film.

vibe.verdict: Solid frontier food list, but the fridge-magnet recipe box feels modern and the cue may belong to the wrong film.
